module-1-inventory-correction-cleanup.label: Module 1 Project: Inventory Correction and Cleanup
module-1-inventory-correction-cleanup.summary: Correct audited inventory values and remove only two approved test records through six cumulative steps.

try_module_1_inventory_correction_cleanu.title: Remove the Remaining Draft Test Row
Correct One Item Precisely
try_module_1_inventory_correction_cleanu.prompt: Begin the approved cleanup by correcting item `2`. Its price should become `8.25` and its status should become `active`. Add one scoped `UPDATE` in `operations.sql`, then verify item 2 in `query.sql`.
try_module_1_inventory_correction_cleanu.hint: The first project mutation should affect only item 2.

help.concept: The project carries each approved mutation forward.
help.hint_1: Keep both assignments in one scoped update.

try_module_1_inventory_correction_cleanu.starterCode: -- Continue the next requirement for Correct One Item Precisely below.
try_module_1_inventory_correction_cleanu.solutionCode:
-- Update the item
UPDATE inventory_items SET price = 8.25, status = 'active' WHERE id = 2;

try_module_1_inventory_correction_cleanu.title: Apply the Approved Decor Audit Date
try_module_1_inventory_correction_cleanu.prompt: Carry the first correction forward. Add another scoped `UPDATE` so legitimate Decor inventory receives `2026-02-10` as its audit date. Test rows must not be included. In `query.sql`, inspect the legitimate Decor rows and their resulting date.
try_module_1_inventory_correction_cleanu.hint: Preserve the first mutation and add only the new approved group update.

help.concept: A cumulative project preserves earlier working mutations while adding the next requirement.
help.hint_1: The new scope requires Decor and non-test inventory.
help.hint_2: Verify the controlled group after the update.

try_module_1_inventory_correction_cleanu.starterCode:
-- Update the item
UPDATE inventory_items SET price = 8.25, status = 'active' WHERE id = 2;

operations_sql.content:
-- Update the item
UPDATE inventory_items SET price = 8.25, status = 'active' WHERE id = 2;

query_sql.content:
SELECT id, category, is_test, last_updated
FROM inventory_items
WHERE category = 'Decor' AND is_test = 0
ORDER BY id;

sourceCheckMessages.updateDecor: Add the scoped UPDATE whose WHERE condition targets Decor rows that are not test data.

try_module_1_inventory_correction_cleanu.title: Delete the First Confirmed Test Item
try_module_1_inventory_correction_cleanu.prompt: Carry both approved updates forward. The audit board now authorizes deletion of item `4`. Add one scoped `DELETE` for that item only, then verify in `query.sql` that item 4 no longer exists.
try_module_1_inventory_correction_cleanu.hint: Do not rewrite the earlier updates; add only the newly approved deletion.

help.concept: A deletion milestone should add one narrow mutation without disturbing earlier project work.
help.hint_1: The approved target is one id.
help.hint_2: An empty verification result proves it is gone.

query_sql.content:
SELECT id, category, is_test, last_updated
FROM inventory_items
WHERE category = 'Decor' AND is_test = 0
ORDER BY id;

sourceCheckMessages.deleteItem4: Add the scoped DELETE whose WHERE condition targets item 4.

try_module_1_inventory_correction_cleanu.title: Remove the Remaining Draft Test Row
try_module_1_inventory_correction_cleanu.prompt: Carry the existing cleanup forward. Item `6` may now be removed, but only while it is still both test data and in draft status. Add one `DELETE` whose condition keeps all three requirements in the safety boundary. Verify item 6 afterward.
try_module_1_inventory_correction_cleanu.hint: The new deletion must identify the id and preserve both approval conditions.

help.concept: Extra conditions can protect a deletion from acting on a row whose state has changed.
help.hint_1: Require id 6, test data, and draft status together.
help.hint_2: Verify that item 6 is absent afterward.

sourceCheckMessages.deleteItem6: Add the DELETE whose WHERE condition keeps item 6, test-data status, and draft status in the approved scope.

try_module_1_inventory_correction_cleanu.title: Complete the Operational Handoff
try_module_1_inventory_correction_cleanu.prompt: The approved mutations are complete. Leave `operations.sql` unchanged. In `query.sql`, return the full remaining inventory and sort it by id for the final handoff.
try_module_1_inventory_correction_cleanu.hint: This final milestone changes only the report query.

help.concept: A mutation workflow ends with a deterministic view of the resulting table.
help.hint_1: Do not add another UPDATE or DELETE.
help.hint_2: Return the complete remaining table in id order.

practice-preview-audit-targets.title: Practice: Preview the Audit Targets
practice-preview-audit-targets.prompt: The audit flagged items `2`, `4`, and `6`, but no changes are approved in this exercise. In `query.sql`, return `id, price, status, is_test, notes` for those three rows and sort them by id.
practice-preview-audit-targets.hint: Inspect the evidence before making any mutation.

help.concept: Safe data management begins by confirming the rows under review.
help.hint_2: Return only the three flagged ids.

practice-preview-audit-targets.starterCode: -- Return the verification result required for "Preview the Audit Targets" below.
practice-preview-audit-targets.solutionCode:
SELECT id, price, status, is_test, notes
FROM inventory_items
WHERE id IN (2, 4, 6)
ORDER BY id;

query_sql.content: -- Return the verification result required for "Preview the Audit Targets" below.

FROM inventory_items
WHERE id IN (2, 4, 6)
ORDER BY id;
